title: Gym Retro
summary: We’re releasing the full version of Gym Retro, a platform for reinforcement learning research on games. This brings our publicly-released game count from around 70 Atari games and 30 Sega games to over 1,000 games across a variety of backing emulators. We’re also releasing the tool we use to add new games to the platform.
body: We’re releasing the full version of Gym Retro, a platform for reinforcement learning research on games. This brings our publicly-released game count from around 70 Atari games and 30 Sega games to over 1,000 games across a variety of backing emulators. We’re also releasing the tool we use to add new games to the platform.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布了Gym Retro的完整版本，这是一个专为强化学习研究设计的游戏平台。该版本将支持的游戏数量从原先的约100款大幅扩展至超过1000款，涵盖了多种模拟器环境。此外，OpenAI还开源了用于向平台添加新游戏的工具，旨在促进强化学习算法在复杂环境下的泛化能力研究，为研究人员提供更广泛的实验基准。

aiReview.reasonZh: Gym Retro的发布显著扩展了强化学习研究的测试环境规模，具有较高的行业影响力。

glossary.explanationZh: 强化学习，一种通过智能体与环境交互来学习最优策略的机器学习方法。
OpenAI开发的用于强化学习研究的游戏模拟平台。
模拟器，用于在现代计算机上运行旧版游戏硬件的软件。
泛化，指模型在未见过的任务或数据上表现出良好性能的能力。
